evidence.title: Arqe — The creative platform for what’s next

name: Arqe
summary: Browser-based suite for customising motion templates, animated 3D mockups and AI stock, then exporting video.
description: A subscription creative suite with three tools: Singles (189 motion template scenes), Mockups (animated 3D mockup scenes) and Stock (a 4K art-directed AI image library). Drop in your own images, video, logos or audio, tune the scene with simple sliders, and export video in any format or aspect ratio — all in the browser. A free preview mode explores templates with demo images; uploading, saving and exporting need a subscription.
contains: browser editor: images, video, logos, audio; sliders for speed, spacing, colors, layout
export in any format and aspect ratio, unlimited exports
one subscription with commercial usage rights and custom templates
free preview mode with demo images
